scope: User-specified algorithm+theory storage and continuing solution-evolution research scenario; current plan/type compatibility, not actual research on a particular algorithm or whole new runtime implementation.
user_requirement: Store problem-solving algorithms and their theory; later recheck via Internet research and LLM reasoning for alternatives, contextual improvements, limitations/corrections and new technologies/opportunities. Track the development of solutions to chosen problems/questions.
assessment: Existing universal plan covers the primitives and staged capabilities. Minimal R1 shape supports problem/algorithm/theory; full structured comparison/research/Watch is planned, not delivered. Universality means extensible domain-independent core, not identical domain methods or immediate support for every arbitrary structure.

coverage.need: Хранить задачу, алгоритмы, теорию, псевдокод/код/файлы и заметки
coverage.stage: R1 minimal; richer structured domain semantics later
coverage.mapping: Entity kinds problem/algorithm/theory; Asset original/locator; Annotation explanation/conditions/assessment; mixed pinned Collection. R1 has no dedicated Algorithm type or arbitrary Entity.data properties.

coverage.need: Использовать сохранённые методы как контекст/seed повторного исследования
coverage.mapping: Lens(problem/context/objective/seeds), SourcePolicy, frozen RunSpec, ResearchRun and retained ResultSet. ChatGPT is the interactive research executor; app stores/query history.

coverage.need: Искать альтернативы, недостатки, исправления и независимые основания
coverage.mapping: Scoped Claim→Evidence, counter-search/verifier outputs, source dependency and AI authored lineage. No found counterevidence is not proof.

coverage.stage: R2 reduced history proof / R5 broader temporal products
coverage.mapping: Original observations/assessments preserved; later corrections add revisions and linked evidence. Distinguish publication/event/observation time, newly found vs newly invented; compare within declared scope/coverage.

coverage.need: Domain-specific applicability, theoretical assumptions, metrics and comparisons
coverage.mapping: Domain profile with task assumptions, algorithm/implementation versions, contexts, named objective and evidence method; no single universal better score. Richer persisted fields require explicit schema/version compatibility work.

coverage.stage: R8 full saved Watch / unattended conditional
coverage.mapping: Watch references problem Entity, collection or Lens/query; cadence/change/budget/status frozen per run. Manual policy is distinct from automatic scheduler; no current background task created.

required_meaning_boundaries: Algorithm/method/implementation, problem/context and theory/assumptions are distinguishable conceptual items even if the early version stores details as notes.
Better is relative to a declared problem, inputs/constraints, objective/metric, versions/platform and evidence; no unconditional ranking implied.

LLM internal knowledge/reasoning generates candidates, explanations and counterexamples. It does not establish external freshness or independent corroboration; model/version unknown remains unknown. Formal correctness/benchmark claims may need appropriate proof/experiments, not only web statements.
External search records primary sources/versions/times/coverage; publication date and newly discovered-to-Bank differ. No-results does not prove absence or continued correctness.
Saved AI reports do not turn into independent evidence when retrieved again. Repeated source copies/citations share provenance and cannot be counted as independent confirmations.
Preserve old evidence/result/revision and add corrections/conditional assessments; automatic silent replacement of theory/algorithm is not implied.
Raw arbitrary code/content storage does not imply execution; specialized interpretation/search or formal verification needs a supported capability/domain profile.

static_recheck.purpose: Independent8-case generic R1 schema/typed refs/exact payload/history/provenance/version check. Not an importer/GUI/research correctness/Watch proof.

uncertainties.item: Full concrete algorithms profile and runtime research/Watch path are not implemented/accepted yet.
uncertainties.impact: Can assert planning compatibility and static minimal representation only; no finished end-to-end monitoring claim.
uncertainties.disposition: Validate full GSU15 at the relevant planned stages.

working_proposals.proposal: Add GSU15 as target/domain-neutral acceptance scenario mapped to existing115 requirements; do not add Algorithm mega-type or structured complexity fields to frozen R1 schema.
Preserve first-version priority UDP-20261007-01: store text/files/notes generically first, evolve tracked research/evidence/domain comparisons/Watch by existing stages.

deferred_follow_up.item: Choose named applicability/quality criteria per watched problem and concrete domain representation/evaluation.
deferred_follow_up.why_not_now: No concrete problem/algorithm/metric supplied; generic primitives can proceed.
deferred_follow_up.consequence_if_ignored: Cannot justify that a discovered alternative is better for the user context.

deferred_follow_up.trigger: When unattended monitoring is requested for a real use case
deferred_follow_up.why_not_now: User described target product capability, not an actual recurring task to create now; existingCOND-001 applies.
deferred_follow_up.consequence_if_ignored: Saved cadence may be misrepresented as executed background research.

scope_preservation: New concrete universality example clarifies existing intent; no retroactive defect in earlier limited work, no115 requirement ID/class promotion, no release order/version changes, no fullR1 acceptance or specialized engine implementation.
